Job Description 
 2027 Data Science - Generative AI Internship 

 Location: St. Louis, MO (Hybrid) | Remote (Available for MO, IL, or IN residents) 

 Commitment: Part-time (Spring 2027) | Full-time (Summer 2027)  

 Intern Program Overview 
 Join a mentorship-oriented environment designed to fast track your professional career. As a Data Science Intern, you will work alongside a dedicated team of experts to solve real-world business problems using Generative and Agentic AI . This program offers a unique blend of technical development, LLM orchestration, and business strategy, providing high-performing interns with the opportunity to be considered for full-time roles upon graduation. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 
• Agent Development: Design, test, and deploy autonomous AI agents and multi-agent workflows to automate complex business processes. 
• Tech Stack Integration: Gain hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), BigQuery, and Gemini AI. 
• LLM Implementation: Develop systems utilizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), custom tool calling, and prompt engineering to connect LLMs to internal data sources and APIs. 
• Professional Presence: Refine your communication skills through bi-weekly presentations to the Data Science department. 
• Change Management: Support the team in training and automation initiatives to drive business value. 
 Eligibility & Requirements 
 Education & Availability 
 
• Current Enrollment: Must be a Master’s or PhD student in Data Science, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, or Mathematics or a related field. 
• Academic Standing: Expected graduation date later than May 2027 
• Schedule: Available for part-time work (20 hours per week) in the Spring 2027 semester and full-time work (40 hours per week) in Summer 2027 Technical Skills 
 
• Programming: Proficiency in Python and strong SQL skills. Experience with software engineering best practices and API integrations is highly preferred. 
• Methodology: Solid understanding of generative AI architectures, prompt engineering, and agentic workflows (planning, memory, and tool execution). 
• Cloud & AI : Familiarity with cloud environments (GCP preferred) and demonstrated experience building or experimenting with Large Language Model (LLM) applications. 
• Communication: Ability to translate complex technical findings into business insights for non-technical stakeholders. Soft Skills 
 
• High attention to detail and a self-motivated drive to learn. 
• Excellent verbal and written communication. 
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. 

 Location & Workplace Model 
 
• St. Louis-based Interns: This role follows a hybrid schedule. Candidates residing in the St. Louis metropolitan area should expect to work from our central office as their schedule allows. 
• Regional Remote: Candidates residing in MO, IL, or IN (outside of the STL metro area) are eligible for fully remote work. 

 Why Join Us? 
 
• Direct Mentorship: You will be paired with one or more dedicated mentors for personalized guidance. 
• Collaboration: Work in a cohort-based model alongside other interns and data scientists. 
• Career Pathing: We are specifically looking for candidates interested in a long-term career in data science post-graduation. 
 Additional Requirements – Internal Candidates: 
 
• Store/Facility Teammates: minimum of six months employment with Schnucks preferred. 
• Store Support Center Teammates: minimum of one year employment with Schnucks preferred. 
• Must be in good standing (not on a performance improvement plan or active discipline). 
• If invited for an interview, must have manager approval based on performance. 
 Schnucks is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
